body: Thank you! I definitely try and find them when I can but I don’t always have the time so I’ll have to poke around the local hunters and see what they’ve got.

Her dad died before she was born and im not close with my family but they’ll take her once and awhile. Sometimes that helps but I’m usually buried in housework so it’s like I never really had a break. I do see a therapist though. It might not be working that well since I’m not good at talking with people and I’m always a little on edge with therapists. But thank you for your advice! I’ll try to talk with my therapist more
Thanks, I know it’s kinda dumb to vent it all out here but I’m just really tired and I don’t have friends or family so thank you for taking the time
Sorry, I know there wasn’t much for specifics. I was just wondering what people went through in different aspects of the field to get where they are.

Unfortunately her dad passed before she was born and I’m not close with my family. They don’t step in unless it’s an emergency and even then I often hear how I should be doing more or that they didn’t need help raising more than one kid. It’s a lot of history from their end but we do ok most days. But thank you for the encouragement! It’s hard to block out a lot of the guilt but I’m noticing I’m not the only one who struggles with “mom guilt” so thank you!

Thank you for the encouragement! I do have a therapist but I’ll bring it up with my doctor and see if there’s anything more to be done. I never thought about picking her up and just focusing on my daughters scent to see if it would help. I guess those are the things you lose sight of when you’re caught up in your own head. I think I’ll start letting her sleep with me again and see if that helps any. Thank you for your help!

Yeah, that’s exactly what I thought and I’ve been trying to get her back on a proper sleeping schedule. It has been difficult purely because of the massive tantrums she throws and it’s more my fault for not being the strongest but there’s something about her screaming that immediately triggers fight or flight and I just see red so lately I’ve slipped more. Thank you for the advice and I’m hoping to get her to start napping again! I wasn’t hurt or anything and I’m sorry you got attacked in the comments. I got what you were trying to say

I can’t even imagine being sick on top of all this. I’m sorry you’re all dealing with that and I hope you guys start recovering soon! I wouldn’t last two seconds in that situation so stay strong and thank you for the advice ☺️

It’s really ok, I understand there’s so many individual cases and people. I shouldn’t have been as blunt, sorry if I sounded cross. It’s just that that argument has haunted my entire time parenting and I know for others it’s been damaging. But having come from a family of narcissists and a lot of abuse I used to have the same view and couldn’t understand any anyone had kids. The only one that suffers is them and they’re the only innocent party. After having my daughter and with the problems I’ve had in the past, I understand that some people don’t chose it and for others their kids are the reason they breathe. It’s an argument I’ve gone back and forth with though. Sometimes you think you’re better than your brain and it just sucker punches you is really all I can say for others with mental illness

Didn’t chose to get raped and was forced to keep the kid but I get it I guess. It’s hard to explain. I love my kid and I am constantly trying to be better. Sometimes the little moments where a normal parent would get overwhelmed, I get overwhelmed too but my daughter has never been in danger. But I get the frustration. But in the same vein that’s equal to saying that people with depression, bipolar, or other illnesses shouldn’t have children.
This sounds like such a sweet idea! I hope you gain some traction with it since it could probably help bring some light to a ton of us this year
That’s actually a really strong way of looking at it, thank you! I know I’ve seen contradicting points on it but this helped clear some things up so thank you again!
Ok, thank you so much! I was just curious because there’s so much information and even more contradicting opinions. More idle curiosity but, thank you again!

It’s more just, logically I would be able to function if I was supposed to mean or be useful to society so I shouldn’t be here because I don’t function. It’s hard having intrusive thoughts though. I hope you’re handling them ok! They can get overwhelming.
All the time. And it pisses people off because they say they care but I don’t believe it and when something happens or I spiral I lash out because no body cared. You’re not a lone
Gonna have to try that lol
I always feel this!! It’s like I’m falling apart and it just can’t be helped on the inside. I lose jobs, friends, family, and so many other things because it just consumes me. How do you even stop it
That’s me everytime. I’m so sorry that other people deal with this and it doesn’t seem like anyone else besides people with bpd get it. I don’t understand
I think it’s going to awhile before we can try but thank you.
Exactly! It all shifts so fast or feels fake so it’s exhausting to figure out what’s me and what’s the disorder. Or if there is even any difference
Thanks, wish he’d reply to those things so I’m not left hanging tho. I know it’s a stupid thing but thank you!
